text: Pinned Alder public API admits Resample4sResampler.complete(plan, receipt) but lacks a public key-preserving fixed Train/Validation/Test-to-NonEmptyData[Use.Fit] constructor. InMemoryData.unsplit synthesizes ordinal RowIds; public Split.* creates Alder-random partitions. M1.06 source therefore refuses native fixed-role lifecycle before reading payload; no random replacement split is certified. See docs/verification/umvpa-m1-06-20260930.md.
